entities.summary: Techirghiol is a lake in Northern Dobruja, Romania, located by the towns of Eforie and Techirghiol, near a Ramsar site. It is separated from the Black Sea coast by a narrow strip of land on which the national road DN39 and the CFR Main Line 800 run, joining the port cities of Constanța and Mangalia.
